title_en: Fall 2026 SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program: Call for Scholarship Applicants
summary: Foreign doctoral students who meet all of the eligibility requirements below and wish to apply for the Fall 2026 SNU Global EDGE Fellowship must submit their application documents by email by 11:00 on Monday, 28 September 2026. The email address is shown only as [email] in the notice text; please confirm it in the original notice or with the department office. The fellowship provides full tuition and a living allowance of KRW 1,800,000 per month until Spring 2027, and five students will be selected.
applies_to: Optional (apply only if you wish), open only to students who meet all three of the following conditions at the same time: (1) a student newly admitted to the SNU doctoral program in Fall 2026 (no restriction on admission track, nationality or home university), or an existing integrated master's-doctoral program student entering the doctoral stage in Fall 2026; (2) a foreign student belonging to a department in which a Phase 4 BK21 education and research group (team) has been established; and (3) as of Fall 2026, a foreign student in a graduate school participating in the Phase 4 BK21 project who is not receiving a research group (BK21) scholarship. Students on leave of absence may not apply. If there are no eligible applicants, eligibility may be extended to students admitted up to Fall 2025.

dates.what: Deadline for applicants to submit application documents by email

Deadline for each college/graduate school administrative office to submit the official electronic approval document to the Office of International Affairs (for administrative offices, not individual students)
Start of retroactive living allowance payment for selected students

conditions: All three eligibility requirements must be met at the same time.
Students on leave of absence may not apply.
If there are no eligible applicants, eligibility may be extended to students admitted up to Fall 2025.

The list of eligible departments is in the attachment (a draft); if it changes due to the National Research Foundation of Korea re-review schedule, a notice will be given in advance in cooperation with the relevant graduate school.
Students already receiving a research group (BK21) scholarship are not eligible.
The fellowship cannot be held together with other scholarships, including tuition-waiver scholarships and other BK21-related research scholarships.
Because Fall 2026 selection takes place in November, selected students will have the tuition they have already paid refunded, and the living allowance will be paid retroactively from September.
Recipients must maintain their status as BK21-participating graduate students throughout the scholarship period.
The project runs only until Spring 2027, so the scholarship will be paid only until Spring 2027.
Only five students will be selected.
Required documents and other important notes are given only in the attachments, which were not read for this translation.
steps: Read Attachment 1 (Guidelines for SNU Global EDGE Scholarship for Fall 2026, PDF) for the required documents and other notes; its content was not read for this translation.
Check the attachment listing Phase 4 BK21 education and research groups (teams) to confirm that your department is eligible.

Prepare the application documents, including the attachments labelled Attachment 2: the BK21 participating graduate student confirmation form (BK참여 대학원생 확인서), the SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program Application form (Fall 2026), and the SNU Global EDGE Fellowship recommendation letter form (추천서 양식).

Submit the documents by email to the address given in the original notice (shown as [email]) by 11:00 on Monday, 28 September 2026. For questions, contact the department office; contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Fall 2026 SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program: Call for Scholarship Applicants

As part of the university's Phase 4 BK21 Graduate School Innovation Project, and in order to develop outstanding talent from various countries, secure an excellent pool of research personnel for the university and identify new demand for study abroad, applications are invited for the SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program as follows. Students who wish to apply must submit the relevant documents to [email] by 11:00 on Monday, 28 September 2026. (The email address is not shown in the text; please refer to the original notice.)

A. Eligibility (all must be met)
① A student newly admitted to the doctoral program of this university in Fall 2026 (no restriction on admission track, nationality, home university, etc.), or an existing integrated master's-doctoral program student entering the doctoral program in Fall 2026.
※ If there are no eligible applicants, eligibility may be extended to students admitted up to Fall 2025.
※ Students on leave of absence may not apply.
② A foreign student belonging to a department (school) in which a Phase 4 BK21 education and research group (team) has been established.
※ See the attachment <Status of Phase 4 BK21 Selected Education and Research Groups (Teams) (Draft)>. (If the list changes according to the National Research Foundation of Korea re-review schedule, advance notice will be given in cooperation with the relevant graduate school.)
③ As of Fall 2026, a graduate student, among foreign students belonging to a graduate school participating in the Phase 4 BK21 project, who is not receiving a research group scholarship.

B. Support: Full tuition and a living allowance of KRW 1,800,000 per month (may not be combined with other scholarships*).
* May not be combined with tuition-waiver scholarships or other BK21-related research scholarships.
※ As selection for Fall 2026 takes place in November, tuition already paid by selected students will be refunded, and the living allowance will be paid retroactively from September.

C. Scholarship period: Until Spring 2027.
※ Recipients must maintain their status as BK21-participating graduate students during the scholarship period.
※ As this project runs until Spring 2027, the scholarship will be paid only until Spring 2027.

D. Number of recipients: 5

E. Application method
- Each college (graduate school) collects the required documents of its applicants and submits them to the Office of International Affairs (국제처) through an electronic approval document.
※ Each college (graduate school) administrative office scans all scholarship application documents into a single PDF file and submits it to the Office of International Affairs as an electronic approval document, together with the applicant list Excel file (Attachment 4).

F. Required documents and other notes: See attachments.

G. Submission deadline: Official document to be submitted by Monday, 28 September 2026.
- Compile the applicants' scholarship application forms into a single PDF file and submit it together with the applicant list Excel file [Attachment 4].
※ If the official document is delayed, please submit by email first.

Attachments (5) (the content of the attachments was not read):
(Attachment 1) Guidelines for SNU Global EDGE Scholarship for Fall 2026.pdf (4 MB)
(Attachment 2) BK21 participating graduate student confirmation (form) [BK참여 대학원생 확인서(서식)].hwp (27 KB)
(Attachment 2) SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program Application form_Fall 2026.docx (188 KB)
(Attachment 2) SNU Global EDGE Fellowship recommendation letter form [추천서 양식].hwp (29 KB)
(Attachment 4) Fall 2026 Global EDGE Fellowship applicant list [지원자 명단].xlsx (14 KB)
